text:
Maya: Heads up — Sierra Systems flagged an install blocker during on‑prem validation. Marketplace image boots but our agent fails to start (segfault). Need an architecture review with field eng + runtime tomorrow.
Alex: Thanks. Any logs? Did they try the signed marketplace image or a local build?
Maya: They used our marketplace image v1.2.0 (signed). Journal shows a segfault in rwd-agent during TLS init. Snippet below:
```
Jan 10 10:12:34 host rwd-agent[1245]: tls_init(): initializing TLS context
Jan 10 10:12:34 host rwd-agent[1245]: crypto: loading libcrypto.so.1.1 -> /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1
Jan 10 10:12:34 host rwd-agent[1245]: TLS: unsupported cipher list
Jan 10 10:12:34 host rwd-agent[1245]: fatal: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8c1a2b3c
```
Sam: Hmm, sounds like an OpenSSL / loader mismatch. Which kernel/OS exactly?
Maya: RHEL 8.6, kernel 4.18. They also call out `libcrypto` in the backtrace.
Kevin: We should schedule an arch review and loop in security + eng-runtime. Also hold off the joint announcement until we verify image + attestation.
Maya: Can we do a quick triage call today 4pm PT? Sierra is targeting go‑live next week — they want marketplace listing + joint PR on Friday.
Alex: 4pm PT works for me. Sam can you poke at the crypto stack and confirm whether our image is picking up host OpenSSL vs bundled library? Quick check: does the image have `/usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1` bundled or symlinked?
Sam: I'll spin up the same image in a RHEL 8 container and run a debug run to trace loader paths. If it's dynamically linking host libs that's definitely bad.
deploy-bot: Ticket RWD-4312 created: `sierra-onprem-image-triage` — assigned to Sam, watcher: Maya. https://rwd.atlassian.com/browse/RWD-4312
Maya: :thumbsup: added eng-sre and security-watchers. For the announcement: Kevin, can you draft a holding statement that mentions a possible timeline adjustment if we need to fix the image?
Kevin: Yep. Drafting: "We are pausing the public announcement pending verification of on‑prem image compatibility and attestation." I'll post the draft in #marketing after our triage call.
Alex: One more ask — we rotated the signing KMS last month. Could a signing key version mismatch cause runtime verification or loader behavior issues? Sam, pls run `sigtool verify` against the v1.2.0 image and paste output.
Sam: On it. I'll run `sigtool verify` and `ldd` in the replica environment and paste results back before the 4pm call.
Maya: If we need an interim workaround, Sierra said they can run the agent as a sidecar container while we ship a patched image. They prefer not to change firewall rules. Is sidecar acceptable from a compliance/ops POV?
Kevin: Sidecar is OK as a temporary mitigation. Confirm it meets the compliance checklist and that logs/telemetry remain intact. We'll document the mitigation in the ticket.
Alex: Good. If the root cause is a system lib, we should also audit Marketplace image build steps — ensure we pin `glibc`/`openssl` and vendor libs where required.
Maya: Thanks team — see you on the triage call 4pm PT. I'll add the Sierra field-eng lead to the invite and paste the meeting link here.
